(FAQ)

Questions

I already have Google Analytics. Do I need this?

Most installs we audit count page views but miss calls, form fills and bookings. We fix what is there before adding anything new.

Which tools do you use?

Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Search Console and the ad platforms you already run, plus a simple dashboard you can open on your phone.

Do I own the data?

Yes. Everything is set up in your own accounts, and we keep admin access only while we work together.

How fast is it set up?

Tracking setup usually takes one to two weeks, depending on how many sites, forms and ad accounts we connect.
